text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, technetium tc 99m pyrophosphate has been on FDA's shortage list for 34 months. Corvale East holds 22 vials of the 10 mL presentation, which covers 7.8 days at the current usage rate of 2.8 vials per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows Curium US LLC and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. with Current status and an initial posting date of 2023-12-27. Curium US LLC is listed as On allocation. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. shows Estimated Recovery: TBD. A Class II recall by Curium US, LLC began on 2024-11-26 for lack of assurance of sterility and improper crimps on vials, 335 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain operations beyond one week. The primary contracted suppliers remain constrained. Four alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today and represent viable procurement targets.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Jubilant DraxImage Inc., dba Jubilant Radiopharma, pending P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase from Jubilant Draximage (USA) Inc., pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to initiate purchase from Lantheus Medical Imaging, Inc., pending P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to initiate purchase from Medi-Physics Inc. dba GE Healthcare, pending P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting allocation increases from Curium US LLC or Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. given the extended shortage duration and unresolved recovery estimates.
